aiAssist.errorGeneric: Could not reach AI. Try again.
aiAssist.errorNoAi: AI is not configured. Add an API key in Profile or set server keys.
aiAssist.errorAuth: Sign in to use AI assist.
aiAssist.errorInvalidKey: API key was rejected. Re-enter the key in Profile (no extra spaces), or set a server key: LLM_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, or GEMINI_API_KEY. For Google AI Studio keys: enable Generative Language API in Google Cloud, and do not use HTTP-referrer key restrictions for this server app.
aiAssist.errorApiKeyLeaked: Google blocked this API key because it was detected as exposed (“leaked”) online. Revoke it in Google AI Studio / Cloud Console, create a brand-new key, and save only in Profile or private server env — never in chat, screenshots, or git.
aiAssist.errorRateLimit: The model provider rate-limited this key. Wait a bit and retry.

aiAssist.errorNetwork: This server could not reach the model API. Check internet, firewall, or LLM_API_BASE.
aiAssist.errorUpstream: The model provider returned an error. Retry later.
aiAssist.errorParse: The model returned an unexpected response. Check LLM_API_BASE and model name.
aiAssist.errorBadRequest: Request rejected — often wrong model name or parameters. Details:

adminOptions.title: Manage resume field options.
adminOptions.intro: Define repeated values once here. Resume forms use these lists for dropdowns and guided inputs. Canonical storage: content/defaults/resume-option-sets.json — saving here updates that file on disk.
adminOptions.error: Could not save this option set.
adminOptions.helpLines: One value per line. Empty lines and duplicates are removed automatically.

adminTargets.headerUniBody: Add universities, graduate schools, and business schools per country and field of study. Users browse the same list on the targets page. Canonical storage: content/defaults/university-targets.json — saving updates that file. Catalog shape: array of { "country", "universities": [{ "type", "name", "ranking_world"?, "fields": [], "notes", "url"? }] }; optional ranking_world is shown as tags and in notes.
